hypothesis: Do not treat every confident teacher answer as truth. Visually coherent peers can identify a single contradictory response.
inputs: exact same current-prefix RGB KD scores, parsed image descriptors and fixed teacher answers as the sealed cohort run; no new neural fit or teacher call
cohorts: mutual2NN among colour-visible candidates; two other distinct queried members required
peer_model: Beta(1,1) plus soft teacher counts; posterior probability theta>0.5 from other members only
precision: multiply own teacher precision by min(1,peer-agreement-odds); no change without peer support
controls: peers across entire query without visual cohorts
temporal_scope: past/current source head and current teacher only; current video transductive
caveats: correlated systematic teacher errors need not be corrected
lone rare candidates are not downweighted
acceptance: full official metrics, same-evidence controls, count matching if positive, repeat fixed configuration and live cost before goal completion
